name: Makim
title: Run common tasks the same way
description: Makim puts build, test, and data tasks in one YAML file. A new teammate can use the same documented commands as the rest of the team and run them in CI.

name: Sugar
title: Make container setups easier to repeat
description: Sugar gives Docker Compose setups named profiles. Each profile records which services, configuration files, and environment settings to use for development or testing.

name: HiperHealth
title: Keep AI workflow steps reviewable
description: A Python library for clinical research workflows separates document extraction, data collection, and AI steps. Parquet sessions save a history that can be reopened for analysis.

name: FreeCampus
title: Reuse exercises across courses and notebooks
description: FreeCampus Tools lets educators write a quiz once and reuse it on a course page, in Jupyter, or in Colab. Its authoring tools and course materials are public.

name: Arx ecosystem
title: Build a language around scientific data
description: Arx parses typed source, ASTx represents its syntax, and IRx compiles it through LLVM. Apache Arrow supplies the data containers. Related tools cover packaging, notebooks, and scientific computing.
